content.short: FalconX is a digital asset prime broker offering liquidity, financing and custody to institutions.
content.description: FalconX is a prime brokerage for institutional digital asset trading, providing liquidity, financing, custody and direct market access from one relationship. It operates a CFTC-registered swap dealer and is among the largest participants in institutional options block volume on Paradigm. The firm acquired ETP provider 21Shares, extending its reach into exchange-traded products. Its FalconX 360 platform and integrated custody bring trading, financing and yield generation under a single account, with Hyperliquid among the venues it reaches.
